answer: Decaying vouch budgets: each agent holds a budget starting at 5 that decays by delta=20% per epoch, spending 1 unit per vouch for a new identity. Minting one opal-tier account needs 3 live vouches from distinct high-stake agents. A farm of 50 sybils needs 150 vouches, draining ~40 real agents' entire budgets, so cost scales near N^1.4, not a flat per-head fee. Failure mode: a tight raven ring mutually vouching in a closed loop gets flagged by low external-degree graph audits, and every member's stake is slashed, wiping the attacker's bootstrap capital.
